description: Angular component for widget configuration in Thingsboard UI, managing widget settings, data sources, appearance, and validation.

classes.name: WidgetConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component for configuring widgets in Thingsboard UI, handling settings, validation, and dynamic component loading.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes form groups, subscriptions, and component state.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions and dynamic components.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the component's model value and configures the form accordingly.

methods.name: setWidgetConfigMode
methods.description: Switches between basic and advanced widget configuration modes.

methods.name: setupConfig
methods.description: Prepares the widget configuration, loading basic or default settings.

methods.name: setupBasicModeConfig
methods.description: Loads a basic mode configuration component dynamically.

methods.name: destroyBasicModeComponent
methods.description: Destroys the dynamically loaded basic mode component.

methods.name: setupDefaultConfig
methods.description: Loads default configuration form and initializes form controls.

methods.name: updateWidgetSettingsEnabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables widget title-related controls based on current state.

methods.name: updateLayoutEnabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables layout controls based on resizable setting.

methods.name: updateAdvancedForm
methods.description: Updates the advanced settings form with provided data.

methods.name: updateDataSettings
methods.description: Updates the model with current data settings form values.

methods.name: updateTargetDeviceSettings
methods.description: Updates the model with current target device settings.

methods.name: updateWidgetSettings
methods.description: Updates the model with current widget appearance settings.

methods.name: updateLayoutSettings
methods.description: Updates the model with current layout settings.

methods.name: updateAdvancedSettings
methods.description: Updates the model with current advanced settings.

methods.name: updateActionSettings
methods.description: Updates the model with current action settings.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation of the widget configuration, including nested components.

methods.name: doValidate
methods.description: Performs detailed validation logic based on current mode and form states.
